title: Identity normalization of global-duality construction
statement: Let D be the fixed finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], l≠D.p, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, and X separated of finite type over Spec D.k. Given VerdierExchange.Assertion [def-sf-all-stage-verdier-exchange-package] (the assertion of [sk-thm-sf-verdier-exchange]) for the structure morphism, for every normalized constructible exceptional System A [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] and compactification c [def-nagata-compactification] there exists NormalizedData [def-sf-global-normalized-construction] on A with the literal point identity operation. This asserts naturality, signed-shift and coefficient equations for the evaluation transpose, its actual ring/projection realization, and normalized tensor units; it does not assert exchange invertibility or constant-object duality.

proof.text: Apply the supplied VerdierExchange.Assertion to A, a constructed identity-point system, and A transported along the right identity. Normalize the point exceptional adjoint by conjugating the actual compact-support identity comparison under its adjunction. At integral coefficients perform this on the complete quotient tower; localize for rational fields and descend through a common finite field.

Transport the closed targets by the normalized counit and the composition comparison so that omega_X=F.G(unit), omega_s=unit and the dualizing comparison is refl. Naturality of the actual projection gives projection_naturality. Transpose the evaluation squares to identify the transported natural transformation with the new epsilon. Transport its signed shifts. This step does not use invertibility of epsilon.

The coefficient units have Tor amplitude [0,0]. Lift their ambient unit maps through the fully faithful finite-Tor inclusions. Tensor/evaluation normalization makes the lifted maps satisfy both unitor equations. Transport ring realizations and their signed shifts. Conjugate coefficient comparisons by the preceding normalized maps; uniqueness of the prescribed q and its mate pins exceptional comparison, unit equation and all ScalarConclusion/ScalarShifts squares. Localize and descend the equalities for rational and common stages.

lean.statement:
theorem identity_normalization (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    : letI : (Spec (.of D.k)).Over (Spec (.of D.k)) := ⟨𝟙 _⟩
    VerdierExchange.Assertion l Ω D hl (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)) →
    ∀ (A : System.{u, u} l Ω D hl (f := X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)))
      (c : Compactification (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))),
      Nonempty (NormalizedData l Ω D hl (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)) A c)
